newsitem.title: FINLAND: Finnish Jaakko Poyry says to buy rest of Marathon.
newsitem.headline: Finnish Jaakko Poyry says to buy rest of Marathon.

text.p: Finnish engineering and consulting group Jaakko Poyry Oy said on Wednesday it had sealed a preliminary deal to buy from Fluor Daniel Inc of the U.S. the half of engineering firm Marathon LLC that it does not already own.
Jaakko Poyry gave no value for the deal.
"At the same time, the Jaakko Poyry and Fluor Daniel parnership's North American operations will be dissolved, and cooperation will continue case by case," Jaakko Poyry said in a statement.
Marathon LLC is a Wisconsin-based engineering company that serves the forest industry and has net sales of about $15 million and about 140 employees, Poyry said.
It would become a wholly owned subsidiary of Jaakko Poyry as of November 1, Jaakko Poyry said.

Marathon would be operated as a local office within the Jaakko Poyry Forest Industry Business Group, with the main emphasis on serving local forest industry companies and carrying out small- and medium-sized projects, it said.
The seller, Fluor Daniel Inc, is the principal subsidiary of U.S.-based construction and engineering company Fluor Corp.
